audience.text: Python developers needing deterministic, dependency-free MSG/CFB processing without Microsoft Outlook or COM interop, especially for batch conversion, message inspection, and programmatic message creation.

capabilities.text: Read Outlook MSG files and Compound File Binary containers via MapiMessage.from_file(), MsgReader, and CFBReader, supporting both file paths and raw bytes.
capabilities.title: Read MSG and CFB files

capabilities.text: Write MSG files using MapiMessage.save() or MsgWriter, and CFB containers using CFBWriter.to_bytes() or write_file().
capabilities.title: Write MSG and CFB files

capabilities.text: Convert MSG to EML via MapiMessage.to_email_message() and EmailMessage.as_bytes(), and EML to MSG via MapiMessage.from_email_message().
capabilities.title: Convert between MSG and EML

capabilities.text: Create messages with MapiMessage.create(), set properties, add recipients and attachments (including embedded messages), and modify named properties.
capabilities.title: Create and edit messages

capabilities.text: Traverse CFB directory trees, storages, and streams using CFBReader and CFBStorage, and build CFB containers from scratch with CFBDocument and CFBWriter.
capabilities.title: Low-level CFB access

capabilities.text: Parse property streams directly with MsgReader and MsgDocument, and write MSG files with MsgWriter for advanced format inspection.
capabilities.title: Low-level MSG access

limitations.text: No mail server connectivity: IMAP, SMTP, and POP3 are not supported.
TNEF (winmail.dat) is not parsed or generated.
No dedicated calendar or appointment API; calendar properties must be accessed generically via set_property/get_property_value.
Direct .eml file parsing is not implemented; EML support requires Python's email.parser and EmailMessage.

problems_solved.text: Enables reading and writing Outlook MSG files and Compound File Binary containers purely in Python, without native dependencies or Microsoft Outlook.
Provides two-way conversion between MSG and EML formats using Python's standard email package, supporting interoperability with other email tools.
Supports low-level CFB and MSG parsing via CFBReader/CFBWriter and MsgReader/MsgWriter for custom format analysis and advanced property access.
Enables creation and editing of messages with recipients, attachments (including embedded messages), and custom MAPI properties.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, MIT-licensed library for reading, writing, and converting Outlook MSG and CFB files, with two-way conversion to/from Python's standard EmailMessage.

uncertainties: The README mentions 'SMTP sender address type' as a compatibility default but no public symbol or example explicitly confirms this behavior.
The README states 'one-off recipient entry IDs' are applied automatically but no example or symbol reference confirms this.
The README mentions 'search keys' are applied automatically but no example or symbol reference confirms this.
The README lists 'validation_issues' properties on several classes but no example shows their usage.
The README references 'PUBLIC_API.md' and 'AGENTS.md' but no fact confirms their existence or content.
The README mentions 'Transaction signature number' fields but no example uses them.
The README lists 'state_bits' on MsgStream but no example shows its usage.
The README references 'minor_version' on CFBDocument and MsgDocument but no example uses it.

workflows.name: Read MSG subject
workflows.text: Load an MSG file using MapiMessage.from_file() and access its subject property.

workflows.name: Create and save MSG/EML
workflows.text: Create a new message with MapiMessage.create(), set properties, add recipients and attachments, then save as MSG or convert to EML via to_email_message().as_bytes().

workflows.name: Convert MSG to EML
workflows.text: Load MSG with MapiMessage.from_file(), call to_email_message(), and write the result to bytes using EmailMessage.as_bytes().

workflows.name: Convert EML to MSG
workflows.text: Parse EML using Python's BytesParser with policy.default, then construct a MapiMessage via from_email_message() and save it as MSG.

workflows.name: Inspect CFB structure
workflows.text: Use CFBReader to parse raw bytes or a file, resolve paths, and read stream data, or build a CFB container with CFBStorage, CFBStream, and CFBWriter.
